intent: Keep evolution observation, incident recording, threshold counting, maintenance-plan creation, and permitted candidate preparation non-interruptive by default, and report the resulting state only in the completion summary.
scope: default silent progress behavior for evolution bookkeeping
non_goals: add a new evolution state machine
validation: Confirm only the completion-summary template changes, existing thresholds and release authority remain unchanged, and intermediate notices are limited to BLOCKED, user-decision, or final-release-authorization cases.
